EXPLANATION: The spectrum shows clear aliphatic C–H stretches at 2856/2937 cm⁻¹ (GFQ-003), a free O–H stretch at 3629 cm⁻¹ (GFQ-001), and an N–H stretch at 3326 cm⁻¹ (GFQ-002), indicating a molecule containing both an alcohol and an amide NH. Candidate 4 (CC(CCCO)C(N)=O) uniquely matches this functionality among the list. Supporting bands include 1033 cm⁻¹ consistent with C–O stretching of an alcohol, and 1264 cm⁻¹ plausibly tied to amide-related modes and/or Fermi resonance (SPC-002). The 3124 cm⁻¹ feature can be explained as an overtone/combination (Fermi resonance) rather than NH₄⁺, and the 2552 cm⁻¹ band is unlikely to be S–H given no sulfur in the candidate set. Overall, candidate 4 best fits the combined OH, NH, and aliphatic features observed.
